purpose: Bounded diagnostic inputs; no previous numerical or functional failure is waived

baseline_common_times.scs.in.change: 401 common solved times, 10ps intervals in 6.649–6.653us input reversal window, retain all accepted points

strict_common_times.scs.in.change: same common solved times as baseline, retain all accepted points

strict_diagnose.scs.in.change: only printing limits; invoke with +diagnose as instrumented baseline

strict_no_lte_relax.scs.in.change: Only ltethstep=0; bounded failure test of reliance on automatic LTE relaxation, not a waveform fix.

strict_no_lte_relax_robust.scs.in.change: Only discontinuity=robust relative to no-relax input; exact internal algorithm not specified in installed help.

tighter_sigglobal.scs.in.change: Same relref method with 10x tighter requested global tolerances and maxstep halved; verify actual log.

sigglobal_traponly.scs.in.change: Single-factor integration method=traponly, only if same-method tightening evidence warrants a method diagnostic.

constraints: No topology/model/stimulus change. No cmin/gmin/IC/nodeset added.
No time shifts or excluded edges. Existing absolute-time union check still applies.
Traponly results cannot be accepted merely because they show fewer warnings.
Common-times diagnostic controls interpolation; it does not alone certify every point between solved times.
Run sequentially under root scheduling; +diagnose and enlarged warning output may be added consistently as instrumentation after verifying installed help.
recommended_sequence: strict_no_lte_relax_robust.scs.in only if preceding evidence warrants
integration-method/common-solved-points comparisons only if needed to resolve remaining evidence

sigglobal_validation.required: Do not grant qualification based on option choices, speed, no errors, or equal bits; compare whole accepted-time union and fullADC physical CDAC/reference0.05LSB after integration. This comparator fixture cannot qualify those absent nodes.
